subject: sr-business-studies
title: Model Question Paper 2
meta: Time: 3 hours · Maximum marks: 100 · Modelled on the April 2026 NIOS paper
instructions: All questions are compulsory. Where a question has OR, answer either one.

MCQs carry 1 mark; objective questions carry 2 marks (two parts of 1 mark each); very short answers carry 2 marks (30–50 words); short answers 3 marks (50–80 words); long answers 5 marks (80–120 words).
Questions from previous NIOS papers show the exam they appeared in.

sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark.

questions.q: Identify the type of non-economic environment: (a) Demand for new clothes increases during festivals. (b) The computer has outdated the typewriter.

State true or false: (i) The interaction between the business and its environment helps in identifying opportunities and threats. (ii) Environmental understanding does not help business organisations in improving their image.
Give the full form: (a) CIN (b) OPC.
questions.answer: (a) Corporate Identity Number. (b) One Person Company.

questions.q: Give one-word answers with respect to types of plans: (i) These clearly indicate what is to be done and what is not to be done in a given situation. (ii) A general statement that guides decision making.
Give a specific term: (a) Barriers when sender and receiver interpret words and symbols differently. (b) The mode of communication that may be oral or written.
Arrange the steps of the control process: comparing actual performance, setting standards, corrective action, measuring performance, finding reasons for deviation.
questions.answer: Setting standards; measuring performance; comparing performance with standards; finding reasons for deviation; corrective action.

questions.q: State true or false: (i) Shares are secured. (ii) Debentures are generally unsecured.
questions.answer: (i) False. (ii) False – debentures are generally secured.

Give two examples of advertising media.
questions.answer: Newspaper and television (radio, internet, billboards also acceptable).

sections.title: Very short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: How do judicial decisions constitute part of the legal environment?
questions.answer: Decisions of courts interpret laws and set precedents which businesses must follow, so they affect business conduct.

questions.q: What is meant by organisational structure?
questions.answer: The framework within which managerial and operating tasks are performed, a network of job positions and authority relationships.

questions.q: (a) Name the process of assignment of job to the selected candidate. (b) Name the process of introducing new employees to the organisation.
What is the difference between capital structure and financial structure?
questions.answer: Capital structure includes long-term debt and equity; financial structure also includes current liabilities.

questions.q: What is sales promotion? Name any two promotional tools used by it.
questions.answer: Short-term incentives to induce trial or purchase; tools: discounts and free samples (contests, coupons).

questions.q: State any four difficulties faced in external trade.
questions.answer: Geographical distance, greater risk, legal and customs restrictions and exchange rate fluctuations.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: Explain the registration stage of company formation.
questions.answer: Documents such as Memorandum, Articles, list of directors, consent of directors and statutory declaration are filed with the Registrar who issues a Certificate of Incorporation and a CIN.

questions.q: Explain any three characteristics of co-ordination.
questions.answer: It integrates group efforts, ensures unity of action and is continuous, all pervasive and the responsibility of all managers.

questions.q: Distinguish between equity shares and preference shares (any three points).
questions.answer: Dividend: fluctuating for equity, fixed for preference; repayment in winding up: equity last, preference before equity; voting: equity has voting rights, preference normally not; redemption and convertibility apply to preference shares.

questions.q: Explain any three functions of a stock exchange.
questions.answer: It gives a ready market for securities, provides information on prices and ensures safety in dealings (also mobilises savings and acts as a barometer).

questions.q: Explain any three advertising media and state their suitability.
questions.answer: Newspapers suit mass-use products and services; television suits mass-use goods and new products and reaches the illiterate; magazines suit a selective target segment.

questions.q: Explain any three ways in which the government supports small business.
questions.answer: Liberal credit, reserved items and industrial estates, subsidies, MUDRA loans and Skill India.

sections.title: Long answer questions. Answer in 80–120 words.

questions.q: Explain the process of organising.
questions.answer: Identification of activities, grouping them into departments, assignment of duties, granting authority and establishing authority-responsibility relationships for coordination.

questions.q: State any five main objectives of financial planning.
questions.answer: Estimating funds correctly, developing a sound capital structure, proper utilisation, avoiding shortage or surplus and controlling financial activities.

questions.q: Distinguish between wholesale trade and retail trade.
questions.answer: Items, quantity, source, customers, capital, relationship and display differ: wholesale deals in a few items in bulk with large capital; retail deals in a variety in small quantities near consumers.

questions.q: Explain the resources required for successful e-business implementation.
questions.answer: A website, trained workforce, adequate computers, effective telecommunication and a payment mechanism.
